_comment: Measured stage rates for the B=180 cut, Preset A (9 frames @ 272x480, d_model=1536). Every value is a phone measurement; nothing here is modelled. Consumed by phase2_profile/solve_cut.py --rates.
units: s per block (T_G, T_N); s per chunk (T_V)

T_G.kind: co-run (Mali GEMM executing while the Edge TPU executed NNAPI graphs; 99.8% of GPU-time overlapped NPU executes)
T_G.detail: median of 25 base-block samples (10 GEMMs, M=1530 tokens, variant tiled_64x64x32_t8x4); min 0.1460

T_N.kind: measured sum: 9 GEMMs co-run + ffn.down downsep solo
T_N.detail: 0.3904 = median of 100 rounds of 9 GEMMs x 4 tiles under GPU load; 0.2580 = 7xFC[1536,1280]+6xADD, measured solo because ffn.down has no compilable single graph (K ceiling 1664)

T_V.kind: measured, hybrid: 36 causal convs as CONV_2D taps on the Edge TPU + the mid-block 3-D attention on Mali (one OpenCL dispatch per GEMM)
T_V.detail: attention is 2x[6120,6120,384] (QK^T, AV) + 4x[6120,384,384] = 32.38 GMAC; Mali 36.071 + 4x3.337 ms, TPU 0.601 s => Mali 7.0x, so the hybrid is the fastest decode and the configuration the cut assumes. N padded 6120 -> 6144 for the Mali tiled kernel.

cut.note: interior crossing, nearly balanced (GPU stage 23.58 s, NPU stage 23.61 s, idle 0.02 s) with the hybrid decode (T_V = 10.640). k_b=158 with the conservative solo pair, 161 all-TPU decode, 162 all-Mali decode — the locked 160 survives exactly when the mid-block attention runs on Mali.
